name: kitchen-ticket
title: Kitchen ticket
description: A kitchen order ticket: number, order type, items with modifiers, an elapsed timer that escalates in words, allergies read first and a Bump button.
docs: Pass one clock as now to every ticket on the board (a number, a date or an ISO string), so they tick together and render the same on the server. thresholds sets in minutes when a ticket runs slow (default 8) and when it is late (default 12). Without status the ticket keeps its own open or bumped state; pass status and handle onBump and onRecall to control it from your list, and take the ticket off the screen yourself. Allergies are set apart in an inverted block and come first in the reading order. A bumped ticket stops its timer at order.bumpedAt, or at the moment of the bump. labels holds every word, for another language.
